arguments.query: use Confidential Information for any purpose other than

matches.text: Visitor will not photograph, videotape, or otherwise make any record of or preserve any Confidential Information to which he/she may be given access during the facility tour(s).

3. Visitor agrees to hold the Confidential Information in the strictest confidence, and will exercise at least the same care with respect thereto as it exercises with respect to its’ own confidential or proprietary information and will not without Hydranautics’ consent use, divulge, copy, release, sell, loan or otherwise reveal such Confidential Information to others.

1. The term “Confidential Information” shall include all Hydranautics’ trade secrets and information that concerns the confidential business or affairs of Hydranautics and Nitto including without limitation, financial information and reports, business plans, design and construction plans, manufacturing processes, customer lists, employee data, forecasts, strategies, and all other proprietary business information.
4. Visitor agrees he/she will not remove any document, equipment or other materials from the premises without Hydranautics’ written consent.
During the facility tour(s), Visitor will observe Hydranautics’ business operations and facilities which may give Visitor access to some of Hydranautics’ Confidential Information as defined below.

2. Visitor agrees and acknowledges that in the course of, or incident to, the tour of Hydranautics’ facilities, Hydranutics may provide to, or Visitor will otherwise become exposed to Hydranautics’ Confidential Information.

Choose Entailment if the contract supports the exact hypothesis (including exceptions), Contradiction if it states the opposite, or NotMentioned if it does not decide it.
A search miss is NOT evidence of absence. Seek paraphrases, exceptions and nearby clauses. Cite all relevant observed span IDs. Never cite an unobserved span.
Each response MUST be ONE JSON object: {"tool":"tool_name","arguments":{...}}. No prose or markdown outside the JSON.
Use the available tools. At most six search/read actions; then submit_result. Keep explanations short (<=80 words).
For NotMentioned, evidence_ids must be []. For the other labels provide nonempty evidence_ids.
Tool definitions: [{"name": "search_contract", "arguments": {"query": "string", "k": "integer 1..6, default 5"}, "description": "BM25 search inside this contract only; returns numbered original evidence spans."}, {"name": "read_spans", "arguments": {"span_ids": "array of 1..8 integer IDs"}, "description": "Read full numbered spans. IDs are zero-based, immutable within this contract."}, {"name": "submit_result", "arguments": {"label": ["Entailment", "Contradiction", "NotMentioned"], "evidence_ids": "array of observed integer IDs", "explanation": "short string"}, "description": "Submit conclusion. NotMentioned requires no evidence IDs; a failed search alone is not proof of absence."}]
